mechanics.name: Brass team

mechanics.name: Cobalt team

mechanics.name: Carried mark
mechanics.meaning: You are holding the mark. Identity only; it never hurts.

mechanics.name: Tether partner
mechanics.meaning: You are linked to this player. Identity only; it never hurts.

mechanics.name: Spread
mechanics.meaning: Each marked player is the centre of a circle: stand apart.

mechanics.name: Soak tower
mechanics.meaning: Shared soak: get inside; the damage splits between everyone in it.

mechanics.name: Line stack
mechanics.meaning: Stand together in the line to share the hit.

mechanics.name: Stretch tether
mechanics.meaning: Two linked players: move apart until the tether is taut.

mechanics.name: Pass the mark
mechanics.meaning: The mark jumps to another player: hand it on in time.

mechanics.name: Stop moving
mechanics.meaning: Stand still until it resolves.

mechanics.name: Keep moving
mechanics.meaning: Keep moving until it resolves.

mechanics.name: One-side cleave
mechanics.meaning: Half the area is hit: go to the other side.

mechanics.name: Player mirror
mechanics.meaning: A copy of your mark appears mirrored across the arena: watch both.

mechanics.name: Pull
mechanics.meaning: You are pulled toward the centre: move against it.

mechanics.name: Shrinking edge
mechanics.meaning: The arena edge closes in: move inward.

mechanics.name: Cone
mechanics.meaning: A cone from the boss: leave its angle.

mechanics.name: Ring
mechanics.meaning: A ring: stand inside the gap or outside it.

mechanics.name: Lane
mechanics.meaning: A straight lane: step sideways out of it.

mechanics.name: Delayed circle
mechanics.meaning: A circle that resolves late: leave it before its countdown ends.

mechanics.name: Low bar
mechanics.meaning: A low bar sweeps the floor: jump over it.
